rationale: Accepted only for the exact saved extension proposal/audit. Independent inspection confirms candidate c56e9302bb9777f1e32cd71da53906dd5b50177acdc39d07e54ca25ade6f2f13 binds authored-v10 source SHA b1c643e30380691f2a272f3e6e26f5dd389cd6485221fecd8114a2d10abb5a38, its unchanged 49 candidate records and 68 archived core/source records, both complete 49-item semantic reviews, current KG/pack/rubric bindings and all 134 saved runtime-file hashes. The prescribed derived-catalog pin 0c2e458ff3f55c51d1a0fd84f4f8628dc6fcf32a71732f786e06257229db0482 and quick pin 7235db2857785a01c829af90e9345702b1cc40c2f6fbf00ba703687fc3750813 match current files and the native reviewed pins. All 49 proposal additions across 27 affected boards preserve the exact accepted pair/result/candidate/supporting-edge identities and absent-core-pair scope; every core, entry and candidate fingerprint checked is coherent. The 294 per-board node snapshot records and 351 edge snapshot records match the current KG, and the saved audit reports graph provenance and unchanged core/routes/par. Source inspection shows boards_replayed/additions_replayed are structural counters: auditExtensions rebuilds each core with BuildProjection, compares its complete projection/core/routes, overlays the accepted additions and calls MinimumPlan with a six-action bound to require the original par. It does not create a game session, execute recipes through HTTP, replay user interactions or test arbitrary histories. Acceptance therefore covers the saved structural/projection, provenance and bounded minimum-plan evidence, with inherited semantic facts and all original source URLs retained; it adds no claim of HTTP/browser or session replay coverage. No audit or additional web round was run for this sign-off.
